## Flags

### belai (top level)

| Flag | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `-agent` |  | start a background agent by name in foreground mode |
| `-agent-create` |  | create an agent profile from a description and save to disk |
| `-allow-ask-without-tty` |  | ignore ask-without-tty blocks |
| `-allow-invalid-hooks` |  | ignore invalid hook validation |
| `-allow-invalid-skills` |  | ignore invalid skill validation |
| `-allow-malformed-prompt` |  | ignore malformed prompt classification |
| `-allow-malformed-tool-result` |  | ignore malformed tool results |
| `-allow-unpermitted-tools` |  | allow tool calls matching no permission rule (default) |
| `-allow-unsafe-prompt` |  | ignore unsafe prompt classification |
| `-allow-unsafe-tool-result` |  | ignore unsafe tool results |
| `-answers` |  | with -prompt, answer the questions the run asks (a goal's clarification round, AskUserQuestion, a stuck goal) from this JSON file of your answers, in order; without it the run asks nothing |
| `-as` |  | the path the profile lists for the file (default: the file's name) |
| `-ask-permission` | `true` | enable the permission-ask gate; -ask-permission=false resolves asks to allow |
| `-auto` |  | hand the model back to the crew's pool |
| `-c` |  | shorthand for -continue |
| `-caveman` |  | enable caveman voice rewrite for this run |
| `-claim` |  | with -prompt, what to claim: LIST[:LABEL,LABEL] (default: backlog) |
| `-classifier-effort` |  | security-classifier thinking effort (default: none) |
| `-classifier-kind` |  | security-classifier stack: llm, models, openrouter-decisions or systemone (jev is read as systemone) (default: models when the binary embeds a model, else llm) |
| `-classifier-model` |  | security-classifier model (default: the main model) |
| `-classifier-phase1-model` |  | phase-1 prompt-saturation model id |
| `-classifier-phase1-source` |  | phase-1 source: embedded or huggingface |
| `-classifier-phase1-threshold` |  | phase-1 attack threshold (default 0.75) |
| `-classifier-phase2-model` |  | phase-2 jailbreak model id |
| `-classifier-phase2-source` |  | phase-2 source: embedded, huggingface, or disabled |
| `-classifier-phase2-threshold` |  | phase-2 attack threshold (default 0.75) |
| `-classifier-provider` |  | security-classifier provider (default: the main provider) |
| `-continue` |  | continue the most recent session for this project |
| `-dangerously-yolo-everything` |  | ignore every posture gate |
| `-defer-tools` | `true` | advertise core tools in full and load the rest on demand with ToolSearch; -defer-tools=false sends every tool definition on every request |
| `-detect-mode` |  | run the operating-mode classifier and report the decision |
| `-drain` |  | finish the card in hand, then stop |
| `-dry-run` |  | say what would be attached without doing it |
| `-effort` |  | the effort of the next turn |
| `-export` |  | export a session by id or unique id prefix as Markdown and exit |
| `-firewall` |  | route LLM traffic through the active AI Firewall (see /firewall) |
| `-force` |  | replace an existing crew of the same name |
| `-guardrails` | `true` | enable the posture guardrails; -guardrails=false is the guardrails-off half of YOLO |
| `-index` |  | bring the indexes up to date first (classifies new text) |
| `-json` |  | print JSON |
| `-mode` |  | operating mode for -prompt: agent, plan, goal or code (default: classified from the prompt) |
| `-model` |  | model override |
| `-no-git-sync` |  | do not rebase the branch onto origin's default branch before a turn (git.sync in settings; /gitsync in the TUI) |
| `-no-prune` |  | never prune idle sessions |
| `-no-transcript` |  | with -prompt, do not keep a session transcript of the run |
| `-o` |  | write the markdown to FILE instead of stdout |
| `-plan` |  | start in plan mode (read-only) |
| `-prompt` |  | run a worker made from this prompt instead of a stored profile |
| `-provider` |  | provider override |
| `-publish` |  | with -prompt, none, draft_pr or agent (default: agent) |
| `-r` |  | shorthand for -resume |
| `-read-only` |  | with -prompt, run checks in a throwaway worktree and change nothing |
| `-resume` |  | resume a session by id or unique id prefix |
| `-run` |  | the crew run to supervise |
| `-session-retention-days` |  | idle session retention in days (default 28) |
| `-teleport` |  | continue a session of your account from another host, sandbox or the web: its transcript and any agent profile it needs are fetched, and the session opens here under a new id (the original carries on) |
| `-teleport-push` |  | with -teleport, agree that the origin host may push the session's uncommitted and unpushed changes to the forge as one belai/teleport/<id> branch, which this host then fetches; without it they are sent as a patch and replayed here |
| `-teleport-ref` |  | with -teleport, check out this ref or commit instead of the one the session was at |
| `-to` |  | with -prompt, the list a success goes to (default: review, or done for a worker that only decides) |
| `-tool-call-mismatch` |  | abort\|strip\|ignore tool-call mismatches |
| `-tools` |  | with -prompt, the tools the worker may use, comma separated (default: all) |
| `-trust-dir` |  | trust the repository first |
| `-usage-json` |  | with -prompt, write a JSON summary of the run's token usage (per role, per model, request composition) to this path on exit |
| `-verbose` |  | print role-manager decisions to stderr |
| `-version` |  | print version and exit |

### belai rc

| Flag | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `-allow-private-cidr` |  | let WebFetch reach this private-use range (repeatable); loopback and link-local are never allowed, and every other private address stays refused |

| `-no-clone` |  | never clone a repository a Software Factory request names and this machine does not offer, whatever agents.clone says |
| `-status` |  | show whether remote control is running |
| `-stop` |  | stop the running remote control and its sessions |
| `-web-allow-guardrails-off` |  | with --web-controls, let a web session turn its guardrails off |
| `-web-controls` |  | let web sessions change their mode, model, guardrails, ask and display with the TUI's slash commands and keys (that session only) |
| `-web-project-settings` |  | let the website read and edit each offered directory's project preferences on this host |
| `-web-shell` |  | let web sessions run a shell line on this host, under the TUI's `!cmd` permission rules and OS sandbox |
